lines: - "Chek nah sis. Glinty thinks he's kicking terminal. Nose grab bombed the landing washed out hard and hit skin on the stretch. K-mart livid."
- Roky: "Pump the brakes, bro. This one's a buyer. Need a ride, friend? The Kubrodons and Vent Pobbers are at your service!"
Roky: "Hit the rail, movin' terminal, klokkit? Grinded for a lifetime offa that taxie loader. Vapor trail. Couldn't touch Roky."
- Boon: "Skill don't mean nah lookin' like you dressed by mumsie. Get your crew decked, look the part. Ain't nobody respectin' a pack of fish-lookin' null-units."
Roky: "Glinty mucker wants in. I tells him: our family's logical, see? Your lot's biological. Mumsie. Dadsie. Luck a the draw. All coddled and swaddled. Mucker wouldn't last ten seconds in a vent."
Boon: "Problem is, see, people are too rich. Not enough to go 'round. That's why we're down this hole."
Roky: "Know how you stop someone gettin' too rich?"
Boon: "You could bigflip off an Orb Mother, come down flair and smilin', but it's aaaaall idiot shivers for the crowd you dress bad, sis."
- Roky: "Win hard, and folks be dressin' bad by breakfast."
Boon: "Word is, Nef's gonna sweep the ducts. Now all the Ventkids saw merc-mercs for the job. They's a special unit."
- Boon: "Gonna net us all up, make us work deep deep down we ain't wily. Nef don't like no Ventkids, an' he don't like no skeg neither."
- Roky: "Yeah, it's square in the D-7 ventangle. Bang and bounce is dog. Keep the whole section up we will."
Roky: "Legs? All that rhymin'? You want that hangin' logical? How we get somethin' his size into a ventspace? With a mallet?"
- Boon: "He's gettin' by hard, same as us. Ain't no self-pity in there, neither. Just grit. Scope it clean and you'll klokkit."
- Boon: "Fam, scope this! Glinty brought Yareli here! Didn't I tell you she was free now?"
- Boon: "Klokkit! Yareli! Here in our vents! You a real one, Glinty!"
- "Lord a the Board, Boon! Lord a the Board, Boon! Lord a the Board, Boon!"
- "Bomb! Wipe out! Get up and do it again!"
- "Shh shh. We got a player. Howzit Glinty! We got a time record on this stretch. Test it to best it, chek-chek. You gain?"
- "Oh, howzit Glinty! We fast, you faster? Drop a board and let's see if beat this loop. Aw come on, let's give 'em a chance?"
- "Glinty! Feeling fast and fancy? Faster than us? Drop a plank and flash some terminal skills. Chek-chek?"
- "Oi fancy, we gonna do this or what?"
- "Cold feet I reckon. They picked the place for it. (laughs)"
- "Arright, klokkit! I say go, ya floor it. Time kicks off once you hit the first marker. Ready?"
- "Rules are simple: timer starts once you hit the first marker. Now, let's see whatya packin'."
- "Works like this: hit the marker, the timer starts. Vapor trail, chek? Ya bomb and ya done. Ready?"
- "No testin' no bestin'! Lord a the Board. Boon!"
- "Yeah, the more ya age the more ya beige. S'Why I'm never gettin' that old. Boon!"
- "Well, Can't say nah bout your skills, but I do like your rags. Keep 'er shiny side up, Glinty!"
- "Nice form. Let's see you keep it."
- "Still up? Maybe you ain't jammin' flair."
- "Ain't over till it's net baby! I still got the record here."
- "Boon's still owns this loop baby! Win or lose!"
- "I gots to checkity-check the mods on that deck!"
- "Don't choke baby! Wash out and you check out."
- "Oof. Idiot shivers all 'round. Ya bombed that one, Glinty."
- "Put in the hours, Glinty. You'll get there. Hahahaha!"
- "You's a lucky mucker an' no mistake. Skin a ya teeth, Glinty!"
- "Ya, don't get smug. You did fine but chek no flair. You scored that one, but I'm still king."
- "Nothin' fancy, but got it done. Ya plank okay for a glinty mucker."
- "You styling like a Ventkid! Whos your logical fam? Where you hanging? Got tips?"
- "You ain't fancy Glinty. You terminal! You got moves baby!"

- "Right, Kubrodons got all the tricks, chek? Been taxin' lab parts since we was sprogs. Primo electromags, that place. Anyways: intake/outtake vent C7A, innit? Back a the place. Blocked, but your ol' mucker Boon here's rigged it askew, just for you! chek chek!"
